messages.subject: Using Packrat with Rstudio Web
parts:
Hi,

I'm using Rstudio web version and just discovered Packrat, which after having a look at its features I believe is a must have in any R project you make. 

I started to follow the guide for packrat in rstudio http://rstudio.github.io/packrat/rstudio.html to find out how to properly work with the package. However, I'm missing the Packages Pane as presented in the guide. Is this because I use the web version of Rstudio? How can I get to see that pane? If not possible, how can achieve to do the same as described in the guide without the pane functionality?

Sorry if the questions sound too basic for you, but I'm quite a newbie on this and I feel completely lost.

Thanks in advance.

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Using Packrat with Rstudio Web
parts:
Hi Carlos,

Is it possible that you've disabled the packages pane? See Tools -> Global Options... -> Packages; within that dialog there's an option 'Enable packages pane'. Is that item checked?

You might also want to check the 'Pane Layout' tab, in case the packages pane has been moved.

Best,
Kevin
